name: Biological Science PhD
summary: Biological Science doctorate with Cell and Molecular Biology, Ecology and Evolution, and Neuroscience areas, distinct from the College of Medicine Biomedical Sciences PhD.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Annual December 1 deadline has no year. Areas review applications separately within Biological Science and use different mentor-selection routes; no uniform admission model stated. Department and central English exemption wording differ; confirm approval.

publishedDeadlines.label: PhD application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual deadline, not explicitly confirmed for Fall 2027; fall entry only.

applicationFee.note: Department says fee cannot be waived. Central admissions lists possible exceptions for FAMU Feeder, McNair Scholars and McKnight Scholars; contact grad-help@fsu.edu for eligibility. Conditional affiliation routes only; international applicants must confirm eligibility.

english.toefl: Department: legacy 92 total, speaking 26; central new scale 4.0 on/after January 21, 2026
english.note: Department IELTS speaking 6.5. Department lists English-primary-country or graduate degree from English-speaking country exemptions; central FAQ limits TOEFL waiver to US bachelor/master. Confirm which exemption and updated program TOEFL section threshold applies. Central TA speaking assessment is separate; English-medium attendance alone is not a confirmed exemption.

documents: Three recommendations from faculty/employers familiar with academic or research experience
Unofficial transcripts for review; final official records if admitted
Biological Science supplement identifying area and three faculty currently accepting students
International official credential evaluation through The Evaluation Company or another NACES-approved evaluator
requirements.note: Upper-division GPA at least 3.0. GRE required unless program waiver granted after an application is started, based on documented readiness for graduate work; blanket masters waiver does not establish PhD exemption. International credential evaluation must arrive for completion/admission and cannot be waived. Cell and Molecular Biology typically has three first-year rotations; Ecology/Evolution and Biological Science Neuroscience generally admit directly to faculty labs. Separately administered interdisciplinary Neuroscience PhD is not this degree.

funding.note: Department provides PhD stipend, tuition waiver and health-insurance subsidy throughout tenure through TA/RA or fellowships. Historical 2024 minimum amount, not current offer. Subsidy covers majority of university-plan health costs, not full insurance. The universal department support statement covers all PhD students, including international students; normal appointment and progress conditions apply.
